title: enginesave restore --json
description: Output of `enginesave restore ... --json`. `result` is null for --dry-run.

kind.description: 0.10.0 (D65): registry is a registry key kept as one .reg file, restored into the game folder for the user to import

resolved_by.description: --game-root, recorded install, install found by the scan, original install, override, env:RENPY_PATH_TO_SAVES, portable:RenPy Data, path_to_saves:APPDATA, path_to_saves:HOME, original absolute path, or (0.10.0, another engine's folder in the user profile) env:ENGINESAVE_ROOT_<TOKEN>, default:<TOKEN>, default:USERPROFILE

snapshot_reason.description: 1.2.0 (D73 3): auto, a backup another program started

game_root.description: 0.6.0: the install local saves go into (null when no local source is restored into one install)

notes.description: 0.6.0: e.g. the folder around the game was replaced by the game inside, or the game version differs

shared_with.description: 0.8.0 (D48): the other games, name (version), whose saves share the global save directory restored into

from_install.description: 1.2.0 (D73 15): with --game-root, the install folder the restored local saves were backed up from (chosen by --from-install, or the snapshot's from_install, when it holds several installs' local saves); null when no single local source is restored

registered_install.description: 0.7.0 (D43): the game folder the local saves went into, now recorded as an install of the record
